1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, and __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes and positioned to preferentially direct light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said light dispersing optic element comprises a phosphor material__.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes__.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and has substantially straight side walls__.

8. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and a single diode resides on each face__.

9. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode__.

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __about 150__ W/mK.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base __and said lamp has a general A19 outline__.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and is disposed within said columnar body in electrical communication with said base member and said light emitting diodes__.
